The '''2006–07 [[Ligue 1]]''' season was the 69th since its establishment, and started in August 2006 and ended in May 2007. [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] became French champions, having won their sixth consecutive title.

[[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] were the reigning champions of France for the sixth time running. Following a defeat for their nearest challengers, Lyon won the league with six games to play, on 21 April, becoming the first team in the so-called "Big Five" European leagues to win six consecutive championships.
